description: Hub access results that may differ from baseline.json (recorded from the Hub at commit 3d56003, before navigation and page decisions moved to permissions). Each entry under "changes" is keyed "<path> @ <caller>" and holds the new expected "result", the "decision" that approved it and a short "note". Anything not listed here must match the baseline exactly.

/activity @ admin.decision: Admin Hub redesign, Phase 1 (lib/navigation ADMIN_WORKSPACE): an ADMIN-role account works in the Admin Hub -- Dashboard, then Admissions (Admissions Dashboard /admissions, Leads, Bookings with its Demo and Diagnostic pages /bookings/demo and /bookings/diagnostic, Booking Slots), Sales & Finance (five Coming Soon pages, ADMIN role only), Academics & Learning (Enrolled Students, Sessions, Exams, Homework), Organization (Team, Invitations) and Monitoring (Activity Log). Each item still opens only for its page's permissions (lib/access). Other roles' sidebars are unchanged. Admin Hub redesign, Phase 5: on the refreshed design (the ADMIN role) the activity log is a feed under a heading per day, each entry's changes shown on request, with labelled filters (action, type, actor, dates) in the same URL parameters, and page numbers. Mentors and tutors keep the current page. Quotes (Plans & Pricing Step 5, approved 2026-11-09): one shared /quotes page for BDE and Admin with permission-based features. It opens on accounts.create_sales_quotes or accounts.manage_sales_quotes (backend accounts.0022), whatever the role; the API answers a BDE with their own quotes and a manager with every one, and only a manager cancels. The BDE workspace lists it as My Quotes after Plans & Pricing, the Admin Hub as Quotes under Sales & Finance after Global Pricing (lib/navigation); every other page is unchanged.
/activity @ admin.note: The sidebar is the Admin Hub's. The page itself changes (buttons, filters, headers). With Sales Management (accounts.0020) the sidebar also lists Global Pricing (/sales-pricing) after Syllabus & Plans; nothing else on the page changes. Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes.

/activity @ bde.decision: BDE portal phase 1 (dashboard and My Enquiries): accounts.view_own_enquiries and accounts.add_enquiry, which only the BDE role may hold (a superuser holds them under D1). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's. Quotes (Plans & Pricing Step 5, approved 2026-11-09): one shared /quotes page for BDE and Admin with permission-based features. It opens on accounts.create_sales_quotes or accounts.manage_sales_quotes (backend accounts.0022), whatever the role; the API answers a BDE with their own quotes and a manager with every one, and only a manager cancels. The BDE workspace lists it as My Quotes after Plans & Pricing, the Admin Hub as Quotes under Sales & Finance after Global Pricing (lib/navigation); every other page is unchanged.
/activity @ bde.note: The BDE now holds accounts.view_own_enquiries, so the Hub opens on its own dashboard (its first page) instead of its booking links; the sidebar offers Dashboard, My Enquiries and Booking links, and every path the BDE may not open sends it to the dashboard. With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Their home page, the BDE dashboard: its Add enquiry button now reads Add lead. The BDE now opens /activity: their own Activity page, which for now sends them to My Enquiries, instead of being sent to the dashboard. Activity shows what has happened to the BDE's bookings (here the one booking made), each opening its booking. Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes.

/activity @ su_mentor.decision: Booking management (Phase 3, on the Phase 2 API): accounts.view_all_bookings and accounts.assign_booking_tutor, which only the ADMIN role may hold (a superuser holds both under D1); /bookings opens for view_all_bookings. Every other caller is sent where any page they cannot open sends them, and no leads endpoint is called. The sidebar offers it, second, to whoever may open it.
/activity @ su_mentor.note: The superuser with the Mentor role now gets the administrator interface (all pages, columns and actions) because /me lists the whole catalogue for them and the API serves them everything. The sidebar gains Leads; nothing else on the page changes.

Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes. /exams?student_id={stu_a} @ bde.decision: BDE portal phase 1 (dashboard and My Enquiries): accounts.view_own_enquiries and accounts.add_enquiry, which only the BDE role may hold (a superuser holds them under D1). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 3 (dashboard and My Enquiries, approved 2026-11-07): BDE-facing wording says enquiries, never leads -- the BDE dashboard's and My Enquiries' Add lead button reads Add Enquiry, while the administrators' Leads page keeps Add lead. My Enquiries is rebuilt on the shared page kit (components/page), its search, status and source filters, URL parameters and paging unchanged, with numbered page buttons beside Previous and Next, and a card per enquiry on a phone. The BDE dashboard gains Today's Agenda from GET /api/bde/dashboard/ (agenda: the BDE's own bookings on today's Indian date that hold their seat). BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>). BDE Hub redesign Phase 5 (Demo and Diagnostic Bookings, approved 2026-11-07): /demo-bookings and /diagnostic-bookings list the BDE's own leads' bookings of each type from GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/ -- searched, filtered by status, by upcoming or past and by date range, and paged, all in the URL -- each opening its enquiry's workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted, the way back returning to the list. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's. Quotes (Plans & Pricing Step 5, approved 2026-11-09): one shared /quotes page for BDE and Admin with permission-based features. It opens on accounts.create_sales_quotes or accounts.manage_sales_quotes (backend accounts.0022), whatever the role; the API answers a BDE with their own quotes and a manager with every one, and only a manager cancels. The BDE workspace lists it as My Quotes after Plans & Pricing, the Admin Hub as Quotes under Sales & Finance after Global Pricing (lib/navigation); every other page is unchanged.
/exams?student_id={stu_a} @ bde.note: The BDE now holds accounts.view_own_enquiries, so the Hub opens on its own dashboard (its first page) instead of its booking links; the sidebar offers Dashboard, My Enquiries and Booking links, and every path the BDE may not open sends it to the dashboard. With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Their home page, the BDE dashboard: its Add enquiry button now reads Add lead. The sidebar offers the redesigned BDE workspace: Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups, My Sales, Plans & Pricing and Activity; nothing else on the page changes. The BDE is on its dashboard, whose Add lead button now reads Add Enquiry; nothing else it is offered changes. The BDE dashboard's booking rows now open the enquiry's workspace on Bookings, that booking highlighted. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles now open Demo Bookings and Diagnostic Bookings. The BDE dashboard's agenda now counts the follow-ups due today, opening Follow-ups on them. Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes.

The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 3 (dashboard and My Enquiries, approved 2026-11-07): BDE-facing wording says enquiries, never leads -- the BDE dashboard's and My Enquiries' Add lead button reads Add Enquiry, while the administrators' Leads page keeps Add lead. My Enquiries is rebuilt on the shared page kit (components/page), its search, status and source filters, URL parameters and paging unchanged, with numbered page buttons beside Previous and Next, and a card per enquiry on a phone. The BDE dashboard gains Today's Agenda from GET /api/bde/dashboard/ (agenda: the BDE's own bookings on today's Indian date that hold their seat). BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>). BDE Hub redesign Phase 5 (Demo and Diagnostic Bookings, approved 2026-11-07): /demo-bookings and /diagnostic-bookings list the BDE's own leads' bookings of each type from GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/ -- searched, filtered by status, by upcoming or past and by date range, and paged, all in the URL -- each opening its enquiry's workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted, the way back returning to the list. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's. Quotes (Plans & Pricing Step 5, approved 2026-11-09): one shared /quotes page for BDE and Admin with permission-based features. It opens on accounts.create_sales_quotes or accounts.manage_sales_quotes (backend accounts.0022), whatever the role; the API answers a BDE with their own quotes and a manager with every one, and only a manager cancels. The BDE workspace lists it as My Quotes after Plans & Pricing, the Admin Hub as Quotes under Sales & Finance after Global Pricing (lib/navigation); every other page is unchanged.
/students/{stu_b} @ bde.note: The BDE now holds accounts.view_own_enquiries, so the Hub opens on its own dashboard (its first page) instead of its booking links; the sidebar offers Dashboard, My Enquiries and Booking links, and every path the BDE may not open sends it to the dashboard. With the dashboard's quick link sharing the sidebar no longer offers Booking links: the BDE dashboard's action row carries Demo Link and Diagnostic Link buttons beside My Enquiries and Add enquiry (each copies its link, with Copy Link, Share on WhatsApp and Preview Link in its menu, from GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and /booking-links lands on the dashboard. Their home page, the BDE dashboard: its Add enquiry button now reads Add lead. The sidebar offers the redesigned BDE workspace: Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups, My Sales, Plans & Pricing and Activity; nothing else on the page changes. The BDE is on its dashboard, whose Add lead button now reads Add Enquiry; nothing else it is offered changes. The BDE dashboard's booking rows now open the enquiry's workspace on Bookings, that booking highlighted. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles now open Demo Bookings and Diagnostic Bookings. The BDE dashboard's agenda now counts the follow-ups due today, opening Follow-ups on them. Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes.

/team/{mentor_c}?tab=activity @ bde.decision: BDE portal phase 1 (dashboard and My Enquiries): accounts.view_own_enquiries and accounts.add_enquiry, which only the BDE role may hold (a superuser holds them under D1). My Leads (lead management): the BDE workspace's own leads are named leads in the Hub -- the sidebar's My Leads, Add lead -- with routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). My Leads shares the BDE's own booking links (the dashboard's ShareLinkButtons, GET /api/bde/booking-links/), and a lead's page sends them to that lead's parent on WhatsApp from the links' menus. BDE Hub redesign Phase 2 (shell and design system, approved 2026-11-07): the BDE workspace's sidebar becomes Dashboard, My Enquiries, Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings and Follow-ups, then My Sales and Plans & Pricing (each badged Coming Soon) and Activity (lib/navigation BDE_WORKSPACE); My Leads is renamed My Enquiries, its routes and APIs unchanged (/enquiries, /api/bde/enquiries/). The new pages (/demo-bookings, /diagnostic-bookings, /follow-ups, /sales, /plans) open for the BDE role only (BDE_PAGES) on accounts.view_own_enquiries. /activity also opens on accounts.view_own_enquiries, which only a BDE or a superuser can hold, and App.jsx gives a BDE their own Activity page; every other caller's /activity is unchanged. Demo Bookings, Diagnostic Bookings, Follow-ups and Activity send the BDE to My Enquiries until their lists arrive (Phases 5 and 6); My Sales and Plans & Pricing are Coming Soon pages with no business logic. BDE Hub redesign Phase 3 (dashboard and My Enquiries, approved 2026-11-07): BDE-facing wording says enquiries, never leads -- the BDE dashboard's and My Enquiries' Add lead button reads Add Enquiry, while the administrators' Leads page keeps Add lead. My Enquiries is rebuilt on the shared page kit (components/page), its search, status and source filters, URL parameters and paging unchanged, with numbered page buttons beside Previous and Next, and a card per enquiry on a phone. The BDE dashboard gains Today's Agenda from GET /api/bde/dashboard/ (agenda: the BDE's own bookings on today's Indian date that hold their seat). BDE Hub redesign Phase 4 (unified enquiry workspace, approved 2026-11-07): one BDE enquiry opens as a workspace with tabs -- Overview (parent, student, enquiry and its journey), Bookings (every booking and what the BDE may do with it, unchanged), Tutor Feedback (the reports, for holders of accounts.view_own_lead_reports, read only when the tab opens), and Follow-ups, Sales & Payment and Activity, still to come -- kept in the URL (tab, highlight; booking and booking_type still open a booking's communication). The BDE dashboard's agenda and upcoming bookings open the workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted (?tab=bookings&highlight=<booking>). BDE Hub redesign Phase 5 (Demo and Diagnostic Bookings, approved 2026-11-07): /demo-bookings and /diagnostic-bookings list the BDE's own leads' bookings of each type from GET /api/bde/bookings/<type>/ -- searched, filtered by status, by upcoming or past and by date range, and paged, all in the URL -- each opening its enquiry's workspace on Bookings with that booking highlighted, the way back returning to the list. The BDE dashboard's Demo and Diagnostic tiles open those lists. BDE Hub redesign Phase 6 (Follow-ups and Activity, approved 2026-11-07): /follow-ups lists the open parent-communication steps of the BDE's own leads' bookings from GET /api/bde/follow-ups/ -- by when they are due (overdue, today, upcoming, in Indian days) and step, each opening its booking's communication in the enquiry's workspace -- and opens, like its API, on accounts.view_own_lead_communications; /activity shows what has happened to those bookings from GET /api/bde/activity/, never who else acted or why. The BDE dashboard's agenda counts the follow-ups due today and overdue, and the enquiry workspace's Follow-ups and Activity tabs show that enquiry's. Quotes (Plans & Pricing Step 5, approved 2026-11-09): one shared /quotes page for BDE and Admin with permission-based features. It opens on accounts.create_sales_quotes or accounts.manage_sales_quotes (backend accounts.0022), whatever the role; the API answers a BDE with their own quotes and a manager with every one, and only a manager cancels. The BDE workspace lists it as My Quotes after Plans & Pricing, the Admin Hub as Quotes under Sales & Finance after Global Pricing (lib/navigation); every other page is unchanged.
/team/{mentor_c}?tab=activity @ bde.note: The BDE now holds accounts.view_own_enquiries, so the Hub opens on its own dashboard (its first page) instead of its booking links; the sidebar offers Dashboard, My Enquiries and Booking links, and every path the BDE may not open sends it to the dashboard. The BDE dashboard's agenda now counts the follow-ups due today, opening Follow-ups on them. Quotes (2026-11-09): the sidebar lists /quotes for this caller; nothing else on the page changes.
